method.midgame: Mean legal/remaining ratio before each removal at floor(N*.2) <= step < floor(N*.8)
method.validation: Each complete removal policy requires a nonempty legal frontier until all arrows are removed; exact Color32 cell colors and dimensions match R3; all paths unique, orthogonal, contiguous, in bounds and direction-aligned; all four head directions present; no asset changed during reading.
method.limitation: Choice pressure is a structural proxy, not a substitute for human visual playtesting. Every individual level need not improve under every policy.
